nsga3.faithful: Das-Dennis directions + non-dominated sort + niching (Deb & Jain style)
nsga3.issue_2obj: designed for >=5 objectives; project formal objective is candidate_2obj (2 objectives) — NSGA-II is the natural baseline; NSGA-III advantage NOT justified yet
nsga3.duplicate_candidates: no automatic dedup of identical genomes before eval
nsga3.test_feedback_leak: no test-set-in-the-loop in code paths reviewed

peem.vs_archive_replay: stores OPERATOR utility statistics, not solutions — distinct from elite archive
peem.vs_classic_AOS: closely related to adaptive operator selection; Pareto-aware credit is incremental novelty
peem.leakage: uses child outcomes after evaluation (online credit) — no future oracle
peem.quality_filter: decay + prior smoothing; no explicit expiry of obsolete operators

ppec.preference_representation: fixed named presets success_first/cost_first/balanced OR fixed weight vector
ppec.control_channel: reweight NSGA-III reference directions (eps+p_i mixing, L1 renorm) + weighted satisfaction score
ppec.adaptive?: 2D controller is NOT dynamic — preferences frozen; no closed-loop front tracking
ppec.oracle: none; but 'controller' name oversells static preference biasing

joint.complementarity: PEEM mutates distribution; PPEC biases selection — orthogonal channels
joint.risk: both reduce to well-known AOS + preference MOEA components
joint.ablation_needs: PEEM only / PPEC only / both / archive-replay / fixed-weight baseline
